lead_independence.headline: Boat on dock lift catches fire in Stuart on Northwest Fork Road
lead_independence.lead: Martin County Fire Rescue crews responded just before 3 p.m. Wednesday to the 1600 block of Northwest Fork Road after reports of a boat on fire. When firefighters arrived, they found thick black smoke billowing from a small boat sitting on a lift at a residential dock. Crews located the nearest fire hydrant and quickly knocked down the flames before the fire could spread.

lead_independence.lead: Deputies responded Wednesday to the 2900 block of North Indian River Drive after receiving a report of a suspicious person.
